zh.headline: H&K G36C 紧凑型聚合物突击卡宾枪：2001 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: G36C（Compact）是黑克勒-科赫以全碳纤增强聚酰胺机匣与自调短行程活塞系统（其后更直接移植给 HK416）打造的极致紧凑突击卡宾枪，折叠枪托后仅 500 mm，广泛装备全球特警与反恐突击队。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：H&K G36C 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2001 年问世的 H&K G36C 紧凑型聚合物突击卡宾枪 由德国黑克勒-科赫（Heckler & Koch）主导研制，定位为经典的紧凑型突击卡宾枪。G36 系列于 1997 年取代 G3 成为德军制式步枪，而 2001 年推出的 G36C 凭借短小身姿与标志性骨架折叠托，成为全球特警队最具辨识度的现代卡宾枪之一。
G36C（Compact）是黑克勒-科赫以全碳纤增强聚酰胺机匣与自调短行程活塞系统（其后更直接移植给 HK416）打造的极致紧凑突击卡宾枪，折叠枪托后仅 500 mm，广泛装备全球特警与反恐突击队。 整件装备总长 720 mm（托展）/ 500 mm（托折）、空重 2.82 kg，成为同期卡宾枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2001 年，德国黑克勒-科赫（Heckler & Koch）推出了划时代的H&K G36C 紧凑型聚合物突击卡宾枪。G36 系列于 1997 年取代 G3 成为德军制式步枪，而 2001 年推出的 G36C 凭借短小身姿与标志性骨架折叠托，成为全球特警队最具辨识度的现代卡宾枪之一。 它的核心设计聚焦于机匣主体由嵌入钢制闭锁耳轴的碳纤增强聚酰胺一体注塑成型，轻盈防锈，奠定了其在卡宾枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: H&K G36C 紧凑型聚合物突击卡宾枪 的机械灵魂在于其「自调短行程导气活塞 · 7 突笋回转枪机与碳纤聚合物机匣」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。双侧可折弯顶部拉机柄左右手通用，且支持向前推入辅助闭锁，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。H&K G36C 紧凑型聚合物突击卡宾枪 采用自调短行程导气活塞 · 7 突笋回转枪机与碳纤聚合物机匣。在每个击发周期中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了双侧可折弯顶部拉机柄左右手通用，且支持向前推入辅助闭锁。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 5.56×45mm NATO 弹药规格与 228 mm（9.0 in）冷锻镀铬短枪管（6 条右旋 · 178 mm / 1:7 缠距），最高工作膛压约 430 MPa，可赋予弹头 722 m/s 的出膛初速与 1,045 J 动能，有效作用距离达 300 米。
内膛技术特点方面，9 英寸短管配四叉消焰器抑制未燃尽火药膛口焰，专为近距突入打造。同时，平顶低矮提把整合全长 MIL-STD-1913 皮卡汀尼导轨，适配各类红点与夜视仪，令其在 750 发/分（全自动）· 2.82 kg 极轻突击 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 228 毫米身管与 5.56×45mm NATO 口径，H&K G36C 紧凑型聚合物突击卡宾枪 实现了每秒 722 米的初速与 300 米有效射程。9 英寸短管配四叉消焰器抑制未燃尽火药膛口焰，专为近距突入打造，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 42 mm 膛轴设计，H&K G36C 紧凑型聚合物突击卡宾枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 4.6 N·s 水平。仅需拔出三颗俘获式横销即可完成全枪免工具快速分解维护。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-48）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，仅需拔出三颗俘获式横销即可完成全枪免工具快速分解维护。欢迎在 BAY-48 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 H&K G36C 紧凑型聚合物突击卡宾枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the H&K G36C
paragraphs: Introduced in 2001 by Heckler & Koch in Germany, the Heckler & Koch G36C emerged as a defining Compact Assault Carbine. Following the G36’s 1997 Bundeswehr adoption, the 2001 G36C became an instant icon among European and international counter-terrorism units.

The G36C (“Compact”) scales Heckler & Koch’s carbon-reinforced polymer receiver and self-regulating short-stroke piston—the very gas system later adapted for the HK416—into a 500 mm folded CQB powerhouse. Measuring 720 mm (Extended) / 500 mm (Folded) at an unloaded weight of 2.82 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2001, Heckler & Koch of Germany introduced the Heckler & Koch G36C. Following the G36’s 1997 Bundeswehr adoption, the 2001 G36C became an instant icon among European and international counter-terrorism units. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Carbon-fiber-reinforced polyamide receiver with embedded steel trunnion resists corrosion at 2.82 kg — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Heckler & Koch G36C sits its Self-Regulating Short-Stroke Gas Piston · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt in Carbon-Polymer Receiver. Throughout every firing cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver, containing 430 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Ambidextrous folding top charging handle doubles as a manual forward assist, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Heckler & Koch G36C relies on Self-Regulating Short-Stroke Gas Piston · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt in Carbon-Polymer Receiver. During each cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Ambidextrous folding top charging handle doubles as a manual forward assist.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 5.56×45mm NATO with 228 mm (9.0 in) Cold Hammer-Forged Barrel (6-Groove RH · 1:7" Twist), the Heckler & Koch G36C develops 722 m/s muzzle velocity and 1,045 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 300 meters.

Internally, 9-inch CQB barrel paired with 4-prong flash hider suppresses unburnt muzzle flash indoors. Combined with its 750 RPM cyclic · 2.82 kg ultra-agile CQB tempo, Low-profile rail carry handle replaces the dual-optic bridge for modular red-dot optics, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 5.56×45mm NATO through its 228 millimeter bore, the Heckler & Koch G36C achieves 722 meters per second and 300 meters of effective reach. 9-inch CQB barrel paired with 4-prong flash hider suppresses unburnt muzzle flash indoors.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 30-round 30-round detachable magazine body with a 42 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 4.6 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Three captive cross-pins allow complete tool-free field disassembly in seconds.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-48), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
